Method_Reported_By_Authors: Propensity Score Matching (PSM) with Linear Mixed-Effects Models (LMMs)
Method_Evidence: We used Propensity Score Matching (PSM) to create a balanced and comparable set of treatment and control groups. To address the critical issue of pseudo-replication, we discarded simple t-tests and OLS regression at the plot level.
